records.subject: Ba2MYTe5 single crystals (M = Ga, In)
records.object: Direct bandgaps in the range 1.08–1.36 eV
records.quote: Their band gaps lie in the range of 1.08 to 1.36 eV, providing these compounds with opto- and thermo-electric properties.
